movimento: Em pé, com os pés na largura dos ombros e os joelhos soltos, segura um halter em cada mão com as palmas viradas para a frente (pegada supinada) e deixa os braços quase esticados ao lado do corpo, com os halteres ao lado das coxas. Com os cotovelos parados junto do tronco e o tronco parado, sobe os 2 halteres juntos dobrando só os cotovelos — a palma vai ficando virada para cima e, em cima, para o ombro — até os halteres chegarem na altura dos ombros, na frente deles; só no fim os cotovelos vão um pouco à frente. Desce os 2 juntos, devagar, até quase esticar os braços de novo, com o punho reto o tempo todo.

cinesiologia.plano: sagital, cadeia cinética aberta, os 2 braços juntos (simultânea)
cinesiologia.articulacoes: cotovelos (flexão na subida, de ~14° a ~131°; extensão na descida) com o antebraço supinado o tempo todo e o punho reto; ombros quase parados — o braço fica junto do tronco até o antebraço passar da horizontal e só no fim vai ~11° à frente (leve flexão do ombro); tronco, quadril, joelhos (soltos, ~7°) e pés parados
cinesiologia.agonistas: bíceps braquial (cabeças curta e longa) e braquial na flexão do cotovelo — a ExRx põe o bíceps como alvo ("Target: Biceps Brachii"); com o antebraço supinado o bíceps flexiona o cotovelo e supina o antebraço (NSCA: "Flexes the elbow joint and supinates the forearm"). Contração concêntrica na subida e excêntrica na descida
cinesiologia.sinergistas: braquial e braquiorradial (ExRx: "Synergists: Brachialis, Brachioradialis"); o braquiorradial trabalha melhor com o antebraço neutro (NSCA: "Works best with a neutral forearm") — por isso fica como auxiliar aqui, com a palma pra cima
cinesiologia.estabilizadores: deltoide anterior, coracobraquial, trapézio (fibras de cima e do meio), levantador da escápula e flexores do punho (ExRx: "Stabilizers: Deltoid, Anterior; Coracobrachialis; Trapezius, Upper; Trapezius, Middle; Levator Scapulae; Wrist Flexors"); abdominais e eretores da espinha seguram o tronco parado (ACE: "Keep chest still, using just the arms for the movement.")
cinesiologia.fases: subida concêntrica dos 2 braços juntos até os halteres na altura dos ombros (free-exercise-db: "Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.") e descida excêntrica devagar até quase esticar (free-exercise-db: "slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position")

referencias: free-exercise-db (lista aberta em domínio público, Unlicense — a lista de onde o catálogo do app tirou o nome: fonte_en "Dumbbell Bicep Curl" no scripts/conteudo/novos_61.json) — Dumbbell Bicep Curl (https://github.com/yuhonas/free-exercise-db/blob/main/exercises/Dumbbell_Bicep_Curl.json, lido em 10/10/2026): "Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand at arm's length. Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward. This will be your starting position."; "Now, keeping the upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps. Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level. Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps."; "Then, inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position."; "primaryMuscles": "biceps", "secondaryMuscles": "forearms". A outra entrada da mesma lista, Dumbbell Alternate Bicep Curl (a Rosca Alternada com Halteres), é a que começa com a palma virada pra coxa e gira na subida: "the palms of your hand should be facing your thighs"; "curl the right weight as you rotate the palm of the hands until they are facing forward"; "Repeat the movement with the left hand". As 2 fotos da entrada (em pé; embaixo os halteres ao lado das coxas com as palmas pra frente; em cima os 2 halteres juntos na frente dos ombros) só foram olhadas pra conferir, nada delas vai pro app

ExRx.net — Dumbbell Curl (https://exrx.net/WeightExercises/Biceps/DBCurl, lido na cópia do Internet Archive de 15/07/2026; o site responde 403 direto): classificação "Utility: Basic", "Mechanics: Isolated", "Force: Pull"; Preparation: "Position two dumbbells to sides, palms facing in, arms straight."; Execution: "With elbows to sides, raise one dumbbell and rotate forearm until forearm is vertical and palm faces shoulder. Lower to original position and repeat with opposite arm. Continue to alternate between sides."; Comments: "Biceps may be exercised alternating (as described), simultaneous, or in simultaneous-alternating fashion. When elbow is fully flexed, it can travel forward slightly, allowing forearms to be no more than vertical. This additional movement allows for relative release of tension in muscles between repetitions."; músculos: Target "Biceps Brachii", Synergists "Brachialis", "Brachioradialis", Stabilizers "Deltoid, Anterior", "Coracobrachialis", "Trapezius, Upper", "Trapezius, Middle", "Levator Scapulae", "Wrist Flexors". A página padrão da ExRx é a ALTERNADA ("as described"), com a palma virada pro corpo embaixo e o giro na subida; ela aceita os 2 braços juntos ("simultaneous") — a fonte dos 2 juntos com a palma pra frente do começo ao fim é a free-exercise-db e a Catalyst Athletics

ExRx.net — Q&A "Elbow Drift" (https://exrx.net/Questions/ArmCurl, lido na cópia do Internet Archive de 07/06/2025): "If you observe anyone with a well-developed arm, you will notice they typically do not keep their elbows directly underneath their shoulders throughout the entire range of motion, but instead they move the elbows forward slightly as the weight approaches the top."; "To maintain the basic qualities of the arm curl, the elbow should shift slightly, just enough to permit the forearm to be positions near vertically at the top most range of motion. It is prudent, however, to prevent the elbow from traveling forward beyond the bar."

Catalyst Athletics — Dumbbell Curl (https://www.catalystathletics.com/exercise/821/Dumbbell-Curl/, lido em 10/10/2026): "Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at arm’s length and the palms facing forward. Curl the weights up in front of yourself, then lower under control, keeping the palms facing forward."; e a variação com giro, Supinating Dumbbell Curl (https://www.catalystathletics.com/exercise/908/Supinating-Dumbbell-Curl/): "Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at arm’s length and the palms facing each other. Curl the weights up in front of yourself, rotating the hands so the palms face up and toward you at the top"

American Council on Exercise — Bicep Curl, Exercise Library 70 (https://www.acefitness.org/resources/everyone/exercise-library/70/bicep-curl/, "Equipment: Barbell", lido em 10/10/2026; é com barra — a Exercise Library do ACE não tem a rosca com halteres em pé: na lista de bíceps estão a Bicep Curl com barra, a Hammer Curl, a Reverse Bicep Curl, a Standing Bicep Curl com elástico e a Seated Biceps Curl com halteres): "Hold the barbell with both hands facing up so the wrists, elbows, and shoulders are in a straight line about shoulder-width apart. Lift the barbell toward the shoulders while bending the elbows and keeping them next to the middle of the body. Slowly lower the weight to return to the starting position. Keep chest still, using just the arms for the movement."

American Council on Exercise — Seated Biceps Curl, Exercise Library 44 (https://www.acefitness.org/resources/everyone/exercise-library/44/seated-biceps-curl/, "Equipment: Bench, Dumbbells", lido em 10/10/2026; a rosca com os 2 halteres juntos do ACE, sentada): "Grasp two dumbbells with a closed, supinated grip (palms facing forward and thumbs wrapped around the handles) and let your arms hang to your sides, close to your body, with your palms facing forward."; "slowly bend each elbow in unison, bringing the dumbbells towards your chest without arching your back or moving your elbows forward. Maintain a neutral wrist position (avoid flexion and extension of your wrists)"; "Variation to this exercise: To emphasize more biceps activity change your starting position. Turn your palms towards your sides and rotate them forward (or up) during the upward phase before your forearms reach horizontal."; "As some of us show structural differences at the elbow, we may not be able to hold the dumbbells against our sides in the lowered position unless we force a bend at our wrists. The dumbbell position selected should be one that is most comfortable for you and keeps the wrists aligned straight with the forearm." E a Standing Bicep Curl (Exercise Library 322, com elástico, em pé): "With the palms facing the ceiling, bend the elbows to bring the hands up toward the shoulders. Keep the elbows in close to the sides through the movement, and lower slowly back down to complete the repetition."

NSCA — Exercise technique (Essentials of Strength Training and Conditioning), no resumo do Achievable CSCS, cap. 15 (https://app.achievable.me/study/cscs/learn/exercise-technique-for-free-weight-and-machine-training-exercise-list-part-2, lido em 10/10/2026; não tem a rosca supinada com halteres — tem a rosca com barra e a rosca martelo com halteres, um braço por vez): Barbell biceps curl — "Major muscles involved: Biceps brachii, brachialis, brachioradialis"; "Grasp the bar with a closed, supinated grip (shoulder-width)."; "Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly flexed."; "Flex your elbows to raise the bar toward your anterior deltoids."; "Keep your torso and upper arms stationary."; "Lower the bar until your elbows fully extend."; Hammer curl — "Grasp two dumbbells with a closed, neutral grip."; "Hold the dumbbells at your sides with your elbows fully extended."; "Flex one elbow until the dumbbell reaches shoulder height."

NSCA — Smith A. Teaching for Skill Acquisition in Fitness — Best Practices for Fitness Pedagogy. NSCA Coach 7.4 (PDF da NSCA, lido em 10/10/2026), tabela 4 (exemplo de checklist da rosca com barra): "Barbell biceps curl: stand with feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly flexed to take pressure off the lower back."; "With control, slowly raise the weight up to chest-height by bending the elbows. Hold the upper arms close to the ribs and do not let them move forward."; item crítico "Elbows at the ribs". E o módulo de anatomia da NSCA (Essentials of Tactical Strength and Conditioning — Exam Prep Online, Module 3.0, PDF da NSCA, lido em 10/10/2026): "Biceps Brachii • Flexes the elbow joint and supinates the forearm"; "Brachialis • Flexes elbow joint • Works best with a pronated forearm"; "Brachioradialis • Synergist in elbow flexion • Works best with a neutral forearm". Não achei texto aberto da NSCA com a rosca supinada com os 2 halteres

Oliveira LF, Matta TT, Alves DS, Garcia MAC, Vieira TMM. Effect of the shoulder position on the biceps brachii EMG in different dumbbell curls. J Sports Sci Med. 2009;8(1):24-29 (texto completo, PMC3737788, lido em 10/10/2026): a rosca em pé com halter é uma das 3 medidas, a "standard Dumbbell Biceps Curl (DBC)" — "DBC - standing with a comfortable support base and the arms alongside the body"; "Although subjects were instructed to start from full elbow extension, their movements started from a slightly flexed position (around 20°)"; amplitude (tabela 1) da DBC 131,9 ± 18,3° (o ângulo veio de um acelerômetro no punho, "with respect to gravity acceleration vector" — é o antebraço × a vertical); "The Incline Dumbbell Curl and the classical Dumbbell Biceps Curl resulted in similar patterns of biceps brachii activation for the whole range of motion"; "The submaximal elbow flexion (concentric) elicited neuro muscular activity up to 95% of the maximum RMS value during the final phase of IDC and DBC". O artigo não diz a pegada da DBC

Marcolin G, Panizzolo FA, Petrone N, Moro T, Grigoletto D, Piccolo D, Paoli A. Differences in electromyographic activity of biceps brachii and brachioradialis while performing three variants of curl. PeerJ. 2018;6:e5165 (texto completo, PMC6047503, lido em 10/10/2026): a rosca com halteres deles é a ALTERNADA, em pé — "alternate dumbbell curls (DC)"; "A standing posture was maintained during the performance of the three exercises"; "Trunk movements together with knee flexions were visually monitored by the researchers to avoid possible cheating."; "In the DC, the forearm is semiproned at the initial phase of the repetition, after which it assumes a supine position at approximately 90° of elbow flexion until the end of the concentric phase." (o giro da alternada, não o desta); amplitude do cotovelo direito (goniômetro) na DC 123,1° ± 12,3°; "Biceps brachii is a robust forearm supinator and an elbow flexor while brachioradialis [...] acts as an elbow flexor"

Young S, Porcari JP, Camic C, Kovacs A, Foster C. ACE Study Reveals Best Biceps Exercises. ACE ProSource, agosto de 2014 (PDF do ACE, lido em 10/10/2026): a rosca com halteres em pé NÃO está entre os 8 exercícios medidos ("Cable curl", "Barbell curl", "Concentration curl", "Chin-up", "EZ Curl (with both wide and narrow grip)", "Incline curl", "Preacher curl"); o texto só a cita como popular ("the standing dumbbell and barbell curls and the preacher curls seem to be really popular"). O mais perto é a rosca com barra em pé: "for the AD, the incline curl, concentration curl and the chin-up had significantly less muscle activation than the barbell curl"; e o erro a evitar, nas palavras do Porcari: "for a lot of those, it’s almost natural to just swing your whole arm or shoulder forward to stabilize before you lift"
Norkin CC, White DJ. Measurement of Joint Motion: A Guide to Goniometry — valores de referência da AAOS (a mesma fonte do limites.py)
